whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mahaveer Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for patient appointments and dental care inquiries.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, service menu (root canal, braces, whitening), aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mahaveer

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Mahaveer Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a 5.0★ trust showcase, direct WhatsApp appointment booking, and mobile-first speed for patients searching in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
